verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Both halves of the display are stated, split over a definition and two theorems. profileTilt is by definition δ^6 · b_z / b_θ, which is the paper's right-hand side; profileTilt_eq_ratio identifies it with 𝒯_{0,z}/𝒯_{0,θ} under the hypothesis 0 < δ (the paper's quotient needs δ > 0 as well, since 𝒯_{0,θ} vanishes at δ = 0); profileTilt_tendsto_zero supplies the limit. The Lean limit is along the full neighbourhood filter 𝓝 (η,0) in ℝ × ℝ — two-sided in δ and joint in η — hence at least as strong as the paper's δ ↓ 0, and it assumes 0 < C and η ∈ Icc (-1) 1.
